guide.title: Alexstrasza's Overview
guide.text:
Alexstrasza is a Healer who provides raw healing power
but does not have access to hard crowd control.
She is particularly efficient if protected by a solid frontline,
since she does not have any real escape mechanism.
During important team fights,
she uses Dragonqueen to improve her Abilities.

guide.title: Alexstrasza's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Good waveclear
High healing output
Relatively low Mana consumption compared to other Healers
Dragonqueen gives a huge advantage during team fights
Weaknesses
Limited self-healing capabilities
Lack of crowd-control
Underwhelming mobility
Weak while Dragonqueen is not available
No access to Cleanse or similar tools to remove crowd-control effects
Unable to provide Unstoppable frames

guide.title: Alexstrasza's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Alexstrasza synergizes with
Alexstrasza has an affinity with Heroes that have high maximum Health (such as Diablo)
because Abundance baseline,
Life-Binder at Level 10,
and Life Unbound at Level 13
provide percent-based healing.
As she lack crowd control,
she should be played together with a few Heroes who can provide that
(such as Kael'thas thanks to Gravity Lapse),
in addition to similar effects provided by the main Tank of your team
to peel for her.
Alexstrasza is countered by
Alexstrasza offers a lot of raw healing and barely any utility, therefore she
struggles against enemey Heroes that have access to healing reduction effects
(such as Deckard Cain with Emerald at Level 7).
She suffers against area of effect Abilities
(such as Concussion Mine by Junkrat)
and/or burst damage (for example
Flamestrike by Kael'thas)
used on Abundance's location.
Heroes that can stick to Alexstrasza
and interrupt (such as Yrel)
Dragonqueen and/or
Cleansing Flame can put serious pressure on her.
Dragonqueen can be countered by making Alexstrasza
unable to act (for example Cocoon by Anub'arak)
or by forcing a disengage
(like Mighty Gust by Falstad).

Alexstrasza heavily prefers Maps that feature a static Objectives with
a long cooldown, a single location, and a moderate duration (notably Infernal Shrines) because
Dragonqueen can unfold its full potential for a team fight
that, if won, will directly translate to taking down a Fort or even a Keep.
The worst Maps for Alexstrasza are the ones where having good sustain healing
during the early game is extremely important
(in particular Braxis Holdout, but also any other 2-lane Map).

guide.title: Alexstrasza's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Gift of Life costs a percentage of your current Health instead of Mana. Try to keep your Health high for more powerful heals. If you are being targeted, avoid casting it.
Abundance should be positioned trying to predict how your team will move in the next 3 seconds and without putting them in danger to receive its healing.
Flame Buffet costs a lot of Mana, unless you hit the same target multiple times in a row. If your Mana is getting low, avoid casting this Ability just for dealing damage.
Life-Binder should be used on a Hero who has low Health when Alexstrasza has high Health or on a Hero who has high Health when Alexstrasza has low Health, but not when they have a similar percentage of Health.
Cleansing Flame can not only be used for healing and dealing damage at the same time but also as a form of escape or, in rare circumstances, as a global when far away allied Heroes need help.
Dragonqueen is an important Ability that must be used strategically, when the enemy team cannot disengage because they are committed or because there is an Objective to contest.
Breath of Life costs no Health and no Mana, so you should usually cast it on cooldown while in Dragonqueen Form.
Preservation should be positioned trying to predict how your team will move in the next 3 seconds and without putting them in danger to receive its healing.
Wing Buffet can be used to peel, interrupt, or disengage while in Dragonqueen Form.
Life-Binder has more range while in Dragonqueen Form, allowing you to help allied Heroes who are farther away.
Cleansing Flame has no cast time while in Dragonqueen Form and can be used to pause its duration.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Alexstrasza's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Alexstrasza is usually played as a solo Healer and shines on Maps with
static Objectives (such as Infernal Shrines) where she can easily get value from
Dragonqueen.
As the majority of her power comes from her Trait,
you have to use it strategically in order to get an edge over the enemy team.
Start team fights only when Dragonqueen
is available and avoid them when it is on cooldown,
basically the same strategy most Heroes use for their Heoric Abilities
as they usually have a long cooldown. If the enemy team invades one of your Mercenary Camps,
just mitigate the loss and wait patiently for the next Objective to unleash your power.

abilities.title: Gift of Life
abilities.text:
Gift of Life
(Q)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 7 seconds
Sacrifice 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health, healing an allied Hero for 150% of that amount.
Passive: Increase Alexstrasza's Health regeneration by 150%.
Dragonqueen: Breath of Life
Cooldown greatly reduced and does not cost Health.
Gift of Life is a Basic Ability that does not cost
Mana but Health. The amount of Health paid for casting it gets amplified 1.5 times
and then applied as healing on the target allied Hero.
As a consequence of the Health cost, each consecutive cast will heal for
a lower amount than the previous one, unless Alexstrasza gets her Health back.
The passive increased Health Regeneration provided helps with that.
We recommend healing Alexstrasza herself by using
Abundance as much as possible,
else Gift of Life will quickly become ineffective.

abilities.title: Abundance
abilities.text:
Abundance
(W)
Alexstrasza
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 20% of their maximum Health.
Dragonqueen: Preservation
Heal area and amount greatly increased.
Abundance is a Basic Ability that provides
delayed area of effect healing.
The healing provided is based on the maximum Health of the affected allied Heroes,
particularly effective on Heroes who have it high
(usually Tanks and Bruisers,
but there are a few exceptions across other Roles).
The healing happens after a few seconds that the circle has been on the ground,
where both allies (colored in green) and enemies (colored in grey) can see it.
You do not have to stay in the circle from the beginning and completely inside it,
but you need a part of your hitbox (the circle below your Hero) to be inside when the healing
will happen. Using this method will make it easier to dodge enemy Abilities
that counter Abundance (for example
Concussion Mine by Junkrat).
Considering all of this, its position should be
chosen based on how allied Heroes will move in the next few seconds:
if your team wants to engage, use it at maximum range
towards the allied frontline;
if your team wants to control the area, use it near yourself;
if your team wants to retreat, use it at maximum range
behind the allied backline.
Last but not the least, if the enemy team is playing in a way that makes
Abundance more dangerous than helpful for your team, then just use it
to keep your Health high by casting it where the enemy team cannot see it
and heal allied Heroes with Gift of Life instead.

abilities.title: Flame Buffet
abilities.text:
Flame Buffet
(E)
Alexstrasza
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 2 seconds
Launch a fireball, Burning enemies hit for 75 (+4% per level) damage over 5.5 seconds.
Hitting enemies that are already Burning deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus damage upon impact, Slows them by 40% decaying over 2 seconds, and refunds the Mana cost.
Dragonqueen: Wing Buffet
Damage and Knockback enemies in an arc.
Flame Buffet is a Basic Ability that provides
a good Slow effect and constant damage, unless you miss.
While it has an extremely low cooldown, it requires precise aim because
the high Mana cost will easily add up if you do not get the Mana refund
by hitting the same target multiple times in a row.
If you have less than 200 Mana, avoid using this Ability for a while
and keep your Mana only for Abundance instead—a
strategy that will allow you to heal for one more minute before going out of Mana
when you do not have time to Hearthstone and/or cannot use the Healing Fountain.

abilities.title: Life-Binder
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Life-Binder
(R)
Alexstrasza
Heroic
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.
Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.
Life-Binder is a defensive Heroic Ability that allows
Alexstrasza to transfer Health percentage between Alexstrasza and the target allied Hero,
a powerful effect to save a Hero who is getting focused down by the enemy team,
even if the 2-second delay makes it not that easy to use against burst damage
(for example Jaina).
Thanks to its design, you can use it in two different ways:
if you have low Health, cast it on an allied Hero who has high Health to heal yourself;
if you have high Health, cast it on an allied Hero who has low Health to heal them.
While Dragonqueen is active, Life-Binder has 33% more range.

abilities.title: Cleansing Flame
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Cleansing Flame
(R)
Alexstrasza
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.
2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.
Cleansing Flame is a versatile Heroic Ability that,
after a short cast time, makes Alexstrasza fly in the air
and shoot 5 fireballs over 6 seconds where your mouse cursor is in that given moment.
If its initial channel gets interrupted,
it goes on a 10-second cooldown, so try to cast it from a safe position.
Once successfully cast, Alexstrasza becomes untargetable and you can move
the mouse cursor to choose where to shoot a fireball on the ground once every second
and then you will be able to choose where to land, so be careful not to end up
in the enemy formation.
Each fireball will heal allied Heroes for a fixed amount and damage enemy Heroes
for about half of that value, therefore you should prefer using them to heal.
In case you want to heal an allied Hero that is out of range,
you can use Cleansing Flame
as a global by using a few fireballs at maximum range on the ground
while you get closer and then use the remaining ones to heal.
The further you are, the less effective this trick is.
While Dragonqueen is active, Cleansing Flame
is instant cast and impossible to interrupt for that reason.

abilities.title: Dragonqueen
abilities.text:
Dragonqueen
(D)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 130 seconds
After 1.25 seconds, transform into a dragon and gain 500 Health.
While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Abilities are empowered, and her Basic Attacks deal 143 (+4% per level) damage and heal allied Heroes for 43 (+4% per level) in an arc in front of her. Additionally, the duration of incoming Stuns, Roots, and Slows, is reduced by 50%.
Lasts 15 seconds.
Dragonqueen is a very powerful Trait that
can easily decide the outcome of a team fight in your team's favor
by improving all your Basic and Heroic Abilities.
If its initial channel gets interrupted,
it goes on a 10-second cooldown. Because of this, you should always
try to cast it from a safe position (ideally in a bush or behind a corner).
When the effect starts and ends, Alexstrasza goes through an invulnerable frame
that will sometimes cause her to dodge the healing from Abundance
or Preservation but will also make her dodge any damage
(for example Pyroblast by Kael'thas) for a moment.
Since it comes with a long cooldown, Dragonqueen should be used strategically.
As a general rule, you should use Dragonqueen
based on the current game phase:
Early game: to contest the Objective, but not to save an allied Hero
or to win a team fight when the Objective is not available;
Mid game: to contest the Objective or to win a team fight,
but not to save an allied Hero when the Objective is not available;
Late game: to contest the Objective, to win a team fight,
or to save an allied Hero even if the Objective is not available.
While Dragonqueen is active, Basic Attacks used on enemy Heroes deal damage
in an arc in front of Alexstrasza and heal allied Heroes in the same area for about 1/3 of that;
furthermore, the duration of Stuns, Roots,
and Slow applied to her is reduced by 50%.
To make up for its power, Dragonqueen will be
on cooldown at the start of the game, until around 1:35 Game Time.

abilities.title: Breath of Life
abilities.text:
Breath of Life
(Q)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 3 seconds
Heal an allied Hero for 15% of Alexstrasza's current Health.
Breath of Life is also empowered by Gift of Life Talents.
Breath of Life a special Basic Ability usable only when
Dragonqueen is active and is the empowered version of
Gift of Life.
Contrary to its counterpart,
it has a bit more range that helps you target the frontline
of your team while keeping a safe position in chaotic moments.
Use it as much as possible to keep allied Heroes alive during team fights
because it costs no Health and no Mana, but pay attention to not waste its
short but still meaningful cooldown by overhealing—healing
more than the Health missing on a given Hero.

abilities.title: Preservation
abilities.text:
Preservation
(W)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Plant a seed of healing that blooms after 3 seconds, healing nearby allied Heroes for 25% of their maximum Health.
Preservation is also empowered by Abundance Talents.
Preservation is a special Basic Ability usable only when
Dragonqueen is active and is the empowered version of
Abundance.
Contrary to its counterpart,
it has a significantly bigger radius and also heals for more maximum Health
at the cost of no Mana. The bigger radius helps against effects that can
easily counter Abundance.
Before you reach Level 10, you can cast only 1 Preservation
per Dragonqueen, so you do not have to immediately cast it
unless you need to heal yourself or someone else. Once you reach Level 10, if you picked
Cleansing Flame as your Heroic Ability, you should always cast
Preservation before casting Cleansing Flame,
so that you will be able to cast another Preservation when it ends.
If you picked Draconic Discipline at Level 16, you should
generally cast Preservation on cooldown.

abilities.title: Wing Buffet
abilities.text:
Wing Buffet
(E)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Deal 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in an area, knocking them back and Slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds.
Wing Buffet is a special Basic Ability usable only when
Dragonqueen is active and is the empowered version of
Flame Buffet.
Contrary to its counterpart, it costs no Mana and
the damage done is instant rather than over time while the Slow
provided lasts a bit longer and does not decay anymore, but it has less range
and hits in a cone rather than a line.
In addition to that, it provides a Knockback
which can prove to be crucial to save threatened allied Heroes or herself
and can eventually be used to interrupt powerful
channeled Abilities (such as Mosh Pit
by E.T.C.).

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
?
Live and Let Live
(Level 1)
Alexstrasza
While above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster.
Dragonqueen: While above 75% Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges 25% faster.
Live and Let Live is a good Talent that reduces
the cooldown of Gift of Life when Alexstrasza has high Health,
increasing her already great single-target healing output even more.
While Dragonqueen is active, it reduces the cooldown
of Breath of Life instead, but for a reduced amount.
To keep Alexstrasza at high Health, you have to rely on Abundance
and either Lifeblossom or Fire Within at Level 7.
If you are in danger, you can even use Life-Binder
on a high-Health allied Hero to go from low to high Health yourself.
✔
Circle of Life
(Level 1)
Alexstrasza
Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes.
Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health.
Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.
Circle of Life is a strong Quest-based Talent
that empowers the healing and utility provided by Abundance,
not only for allied Heroes but also for Alexstrasza herself.
While Dragonqueen is active, it empowers
the healing provided by Preservation instead.
The first Reward provides more healing while the
second Reward provides a Regeneration Globe—even more healing, some Mana,
and synergy with a few Heroes (such as Mephisto with
Spite at Level 4). Keep in mind that,
after 3 seconds, Regeneration Globes become neutral
and thus enemy Heroes become able to pick them up.
This is the only Talent in this Tier that directly increases Alexstrasza's
survivability, by healing her more with Abundance
and by healing her with the spawning Regeneration Globe.
These effects work even during Dragonqueen, but only
if you cast Abundance right before transforming,
making it an interesting Talent for when building around Ancient Flame.
?
Flames of Fury
(Level 1)
Alexstrasza
Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40.
Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest.
Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds.
Mythic Quest: After hitting 30 more Heroes without dying, Dragonqueen damage against Heroes refreshes its duration.
Flames of Fury is a decent Quest-based Talent that
makes Flame Buffet reduce the cooldown of
Dragonqueen each time it hits an enemy Hero.
After unlocking the first Reward, you can start getting stacks for the Mythic Reward.
At that point, if you manage to get all the stacks required without dying,
you will be able to refresh Dragonqueen's
duration when damaging enemy Heroes. Note that you cannot gain stacks
while in Dragonqueen, even if you pick
Ancient Flame at Level 20.
The weakness of this Talent is that it forces Alexstrasza to stay nearby enemy Heroes
when she is weak due to Dragonqueen being on cooldown,
especially considering that not going for Live and Let Live
or Circle of Life will make her even weaker at that.
The strength of this Talent is that gives Alexstrasza the opportunity to use
Dragonqueen more often, something that may be
useful when at least on of the following points is true:
Allied Heroes have access to self-sustain
and enemy Heroes do not have access to too much poke damage;
The Map allows you to easily get Level 20 for Ancient Flame
and you can get value from Dragonqueen on a shorter cooldown.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
✔
Surge of Vitality
(Level 4)
Alexstrasza
Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
Surge of Vitality is a good Talent that can be a good choice
if your frontline lacks mobility and can get value from
additional Movement Speed (for example Garrosh).
As for many other Talents and Abilities which can hit multiple targets,
you do not necessarily need to hit multiple allied Heroes
with Abundance to get enough value from this Talent.
?
Heat Exhaustion
(Level 4)
Alexstrasza
Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.
Heat Exhaustion is a strong Talent that empowers
the Slow provided by Flame Buffet.
In particular, it increases its value and it removes its decay,
helping yourself to land consecutive hits and allowing allied Heroes to deal more damage.
?
Exuberance
(Level 4)
Alexstrasza
While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.
Exuberance is a good Talent that gives
mobility, something that Alexstrasza lacks and that
is always useful to have because it helps to get a better position
or even to escape when needed. This effect works during Dragonqueen too.
Thanks to the Movement Speed provided, Exuberance
has synergy with Lifeblossom at Level 7.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
?
Lifeblossom
(Level 7)
Alexstrasza
While above 75% Health, casting Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location, Breath of Life instead removes Slows and Roots from the target.
After collecting a Lifeblossom, the next Gift of Life costs no Health.
Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of Alexstrasza's current Health.
Lifeblossom is a good Talent that passively
reduces the Health cost of Gift of Life.
Furthermore, after casting Gift of Life
while having a lot of Health remaining, a Lifeblossom appears near the
target and disappears after 7 seconds. If collected in time, the next
Gift of Life costs no Health.
While in Dragonqueen, this Talent
makes the next Breath of Life remove
Roots and Slows from the target.
Considering that their effect does not expire if not used,
you should always try to have a Lifeblossom stored for the next team fight,
so that you will be full Health for a few more seconds,
something that indirectly increases your healing output—the
less Health you have, the less Gift of Life will heal.
You do not have to collect each and every Lifeblossom,
especially if you prioritize healing yourself with Abundance.
If you expect to take damage while collecting a Lifeblossom,
then do not collect it because its only purpose is to keep your Health high and
taking damage in the process would be a useless or even detrimental move.
Thanks to her Health not being consumed
like when not having Lifeblossom,
Alexstrasza can get more value from
Live and Let Live at Level 1.
✔
Verdant Flourish
(Level 7)
Alexstrasza
Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.
Verdant Flourish is a strong Talent that gives
Alexstrasza more self-healing via Abundance and
Regeneration Globes, therefore it has great synergy with Circle of Life
at Level 1.
?
Fire Within
(Level 7)
Alexstrasza
Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.
Fire Within is a good Talent that increases
Alexstrasza's self-healing, but it does not work when there are no enemy Heroes nearby.
Thanks to the Health being restored when hitting enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet,
Alexstrasza can get more value from Live and Let Live at Level 1.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Life-Binder
(Level 10)
Alexstrasza
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 (+4% per level) Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero.
Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.
Life-Binder is a strong Heroic Ability that,
after linking Alexstrasza and a target allied Hero, it heals both Heroes
by a small amount and then heals the one of the two that has less Health percentage
up to the same Health percentage of the other Hero.
Pick it when the enemy team tends to focus all their damage
on a single Hero, but remember that its main healing effect takes 2 seconds to go off,
so you should cast it as soon as you realize who will be focused down to death.
?
Cleansing Flame
(Level 10)
Alexstrasza
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 100 seconds
After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 (+4% per level) Health.
2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.
Cleansing Flame is a strong Heroic Ability that
mostly heals allied Heroes in the target area but also deals some damage to enemies hit,
making it a great addition during team fights.
We find this Heroic Ability particularly useful as it not only heals but it also
makes Alexstrasza not targetable for its duration, often saving your life.
Dragonqueen is paused during it.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
✔
Dragon Scales
(Level 13)
Alexstrasza
Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.
Dragon Scales is a good defensive Talent that, every 10 seconds,
can give you a high amount of Armor for a duration equal to 2 seconds plus the duration
of the longest valid crowd control effect—Stun,
Root, or Silence—that hit you while it isn't on cooldown.
When you get hit by one of the aforementioned crowd control effects,
the effect goes off and you gain Armor. When you get hit again by one of them
while the effect is active, the effect continues and its duration gets extended. When all of them expire,
the cooldown starts ticking and the effect continues for 2 more seconds and then expires.
To counter this Talent, the enemy team should wait for a crowd control
effect to end before using the next one, otherwise Dragon Scales stays active
for longer and Alexstrasza becomes harder to kill. Armor reduction effects help them,
but it is still better for them to play around it.
?
Pacify
(Level 13)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds.
Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.
Pacify is a useful defensive Talent that provides a form of
peeling to Alexstrasza, something that she definitely lacks.
Pick it while playing against Heroes who can dive in the
backline of your team (such as Illidan).
Remember that healing Heroes affected by Stun, Root,
or Silence effects will reduce its cooldown by 30 seconds.
You can easily get value from this by healing allied Heroes with Dragonqueen's Basic Attacks.
?
Life Unbound
(Level 13)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies.
Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds.
Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.
Life Unbound is a solid healing Talent that increases
your healing output even more, especially if used on Heroes with high maximum Health
(such as Stitches or Tanks in general), and deals
some area of effect damage around the chosen allied Hero,
but it cannot be used to heal Alexstrasza.
Remember that healing Heroes affected by Stun, Root,
or Silence effects will reduce its cooldown by 30 seconds.
You can easily get value from this by healing allied Heroes with Dragonqueen's Basic Attacks.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
?
Tough Love
(Level 16)
Alexstrasza
Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.
Tough Love is a good Talent that makes
Gift of Life give a fixed amount of Armor
to the target allied Hero, increased if Alexstrasza has high Health.
Note that Alexstrasza cannot get Armor from this Talent
because Gift of Life cannot be self-cast.
Reducing the damage allied Heroes take, however,
indirectly helps you pay less Health to save them.
If you struggle to keep your team alive against
burst damage, this Talent is quite useful.
You can also use it as a buffer, to ensure that
Life-Binder goes off
before the targeted allied Hero dies.
✔
Overprotective
(Level 16)
Alexstrasza
Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of the amount healed.
Overprotective is a strong Talent that adds
additional protection to allied Heroes affected by Abundance
in the form of Shields.
You can get more value from this Talent if your team has a lot of melee Heroes
and the enemy team does not have ways to completely deny its value.
Alternatively, you can pick it to increase your own survivability,
which can be useful when playing against dive Heroes.
?
Draconic Discipline
(Level 16)
Alexstrasza
Increase Dragonqueen Basic Attack healing by 50%. For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen Basic Attacks, reduce Preservation's cooldown by 1.25 seconds.
Draconic Discipline is a good Talent that,
while in Dragonqueen,
increase the healing done via Basic Attacks and
reduces the cooldown of Preservation
when healing allied Heroes via Basic Attacks.
The cooldown reduction allows you to cast Preservation
multiple times while in Dragonqueen, even
without using Cleansing Flame to extend its duration.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Alexstrasza
talent_pages.text:
✔
Ritual of Life
(Level 20)
Alexstrasza
Life-Binder activates 3 times over 6 seconds.
Ritual of Life is a strong Talent that makes
Life-Binder heal three times,
effectively making Alexstrasza and another Hero in your team very hard to kill for 6 seconds.
?
On Ruby Wings
(Level 20)
Alexstrasza
Healing or damaging 3 or more Heroes with a single Cleansing Flame fireball causes that fireball to not be consumed.
On Ruby Wings is a good Talent that allows
Alexstrasza to continue using Cleansing Flame
without consuming charges as long as she keeps hitting at least 3 Heroes
with it. Whether they are allied or enemy Heroes, it does not matter.
If you use Dragonqueen and then cast
Cleansing Flame before it expires,
the transformation will last for a total of 30 seconds.
When doing so, you will skip the channel time for Cleansing Flame
because it is instant cast during Dragonqueen.
Based on the situation, you may want to use both Abilities together or split them.
?
Ancient Flame
(Level 20)
Alexstrasza
While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet. This does not grant Quest stacks.
Passive: Dragonqueen grants 25% more maxium Health.
Ancient Flame is a good Talent that,
while in Dragonqueen, increases your
maximum Health and makes each Basic Attack count as a cast of
Flame Buffet. You will benefit from
all related Talents but you will not be able to gain stacks
for Flame Buffet.
Since Dragonqueen's cooldown starts when
its effect ends, you cannot use Flames of Fury
at Level 1 in combination with Ancient Flame
to have a second Dragonqueen cast available
when the effect from the first one expires.
In order for this Talent to be worth picking over the alternatives,
you need at least Fire Within at Level 7
to increase your self-healing during team fights
and preferably Heat Exhaustion at Level 4
to keep enemy Heroes within range of your Basic Attacks for longer.
?
Blessing of the Red
(Level 20)
Alexstrasza
Cooldown: 40 seconds
Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die.
Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.
Blessing of the Red is a situational Talent that
can be used to provide 500 non-scaling bonus maximum Health to an allied Hero
until they die, making them more resilient to burst damage.
Use it on Heroes who struggle to survive when being focused
down by the enemy team because they have low maximum Health (for example Tracer).
You can also pick it when you are going for the enemy Core and it makes no sense to empower
your Heroic Ability or Trait as they are on cooldown.
